items.title: Test reliability: ~12–15 long journeys, a brittleness audit, fix-it-properly rules, screenshots out of the gate
items.summary: The browser test suite is rebuilt as 14 long journeys (start page, opening, reading, threads, submit and Outbox, diff, versions and Since, personas, settings, recovery, documents, extension, static demo, debug): 357 tests in 97 files become 191 in 16, with far fewer service starts. Screenshot capture moved to an on-demand tour (mise run visual-tour), test:affected runs the journeys on one throttled core to catch timing races early, and AGENTS.md has fix-it-properly rules for flaky tests. No change in the app.

items.title: Test services can resolve the real gh via the login-shell PATH (tests reached GitHub read-only)
items.summary: Test-only safety fix: a test-started Unvibe service no longer applies the login shell’s PATH, and refuses to run any gh, git or agent CLI that is not the test harness’s fake. Before, a broken test setup could make a test service call the real gh with your login (read-only). No change in the app you use.
